name: live-v19-repair-deep-link
objective: v2.3 replan V19 on a real SillyTavern (no model needed), moved to the workspace (owner UI rule 2026-10-18, commit 83473666: the HUD chip and the settings 'Story setup and repair' button open This story > Play at `#so-setup`; the drawer-footer Repair button is gone). With no memory model chosen, the HUD setup chip (`#so-hud-setup`) must open the story window AND bring its Setup section into view, not just open the window; the Extensions settings entry point (`#so-open-setup`, 'Story setup and repair') must land on the same section. Each control is hit-tested first, so a covered control fails here instead of being clicked by script. The memory model is install state: so-scenario restores the extraction settings at cleanup.

import_story.title: SO-V19 Repair
import_story.description: One checkpoint; the check is about setup, not play.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ profileId: null }); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500)); const snapshot = rt.getSnapshot(); if (!snapshot.pipeline.needsSetup) throw new Error(`clearing the memory model did not put the pipeline in needs-setup: ${JSON.stringify(snapshot.pipeline)}`); const nav = document.getElementById('rm_extensions_block'); if (nav?.classList.contains('openDrawer')) document.querySelector('#extensions-settings-button .drawer-toggle')?.click(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 400)); return { pipeline: snapshot.pipeline.state, navOpen: document.getElementById('rm_extensions_block')?.classList.contains('openDrawer') };

const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error(`timed out after ${ms} ms: ${what}`); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } }; document.querySelector('#so-hud-setup').click(); const opened = await until(() => document.getElementById('so-workspace-modal')?.open, 5000, 'the HUD chip did not open the story window').catch((error) => { throw new Error('the HUD chip did not open the story window'); }); const setup = await until(() => document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open] #so-setup'), 5000, 'the HUD chip opened the story window but not its Setup section (#so-setup)'); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 600)); const ws = document.getElementById('so-workspace-modal'); if (ws.getAttribute('data-context') !== 'story') throw new Error(`the HUD chip opened the ${ws.getAttribute('data-context')} context, not This story`); const rect = setup.getBoundingClientRect(); const inView = setup.offsetParent !== null && rect.bottom > 0 && rect.top < innerHeight; if (!inView) throw new Error(`the HUD chip opened the story window but did not bring the Setup section into view (top=${Math.round(rect.top)}, bottom=${Math.round(rect.bottom)}, viewport=${innerHeight})`); if (!setup.querySelector('[data-so="setup-row"]')) throw new Error('the Setup section the chip landed on lists no setup row for the missing memory model'); return { opened, context: ws.getAttribute('data-context'), setup: setup.textContent.slice(0, 120) };

const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error(`timed out after ${ms} ms: ${what}`); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } }; const closeWs = async () => { document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open] [aria-label="Close Story Orchestrator"]')?.click(); await until(() => !document.getElementById('so-workspace-modal')?.open, 5000, 'the story window to close'); }; await closeWs(); globalThis.toastr?.remove?.(); const nav = document.getElementById('rm_extensions_block'); if (!nav?.classList.contains('openDrawer')) document.querySelector('#extensions-settings-button .drawer-toggle')?.click(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 600)); return { navOpen: document.getElementById('rm_extensions_block')?.classList.contains('openDrawer') };

const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error(`timed out after ${ms} ms: ${what}`); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } }; const closeWs = async () => { document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open] [aria-label="Close Story Orchestrator"]')?.click(); await until(() => !document.getElementById('so-workspace-modal')?.open, 5000, 'the story window to close'); }; const button = document.getElementById('so-open-setup'); if (!/setup and repair/i.test(button?.textContent ?? '')) throw new Error(`the settings entry point does not name setup and repair: ${button?.textContent}`); const label = button.textContent; button.click(); const setup = await until(() => document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open] #so-setup'), 5000, 'the settings Story setup and repair button did not land on the Setup section (#so-setup)'); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 600)); const ws = document.getElementById('so-workspace-modal'); if (ws.getAttribute('data-context') !== 'story') throw new Error(`the settings entry point opened the ${ws.getAttribute('data-context')} context, not This story`); const rect = setup.getBoundingClientRect(); const inView = setup.offsetParent !== null && rect.bottom > 0 && rect.top < innerHeight; if (!inView) throw new Error(`the settings entry point opened the story window but did not bring the Setup section into view (top=${Math.round(rect.top)}, bottom=${Math.round(rect.bottom)}, viewport=${innerHeight})`); if (!setup.querySelector('[data-so="setup-row"]')) throw new Error('the Setup section the settings entry point landed on lists no setup row for the missing memory model'); await closeWs(); if (document.getElementById('rm_extensions_block')?.classList.contains('openDrawer')) document.querySelector('#extensions-settings-button .drawer-toggle')?.click(); return { label, landed: true };
